blacklistabilityReview.evidence: fxSAVE is Possible because its tokenized ERC4626 Stability Pool share implementation remains admin-upgradeable on its sole registered Ethereum deployment (100% of tracked deployment supply; census circulating supply unavailable). At Ethereum block 26224762 (2026-10-19T06:14:35Z), proxy 0x7743e50f534a7f9f1791dde7dcd89f7783eefc39 resolves to verified SavingFxUSD implementation 0xe4031e271809d20074e4bef1caeefec5f710e8a6; asset() returns fxSP 0x65c9a641afceb9c0e6034e558a319488fa0fa3be. The current implementation retains ordinary ERC20/ERC4626 transfers without pause, blacklist, freeze, recipient blocklist or arbitrary-outstanding-holder-share-burn paths. CLAIM_FOR_ROLE permits claimFor() only for an already initiated redemption claim; it does not bypass share-burn/allowance checks on outstanding fxSAVE. EIP-1967 admin is ProxyAdmin 0x9b54b7703551d9d0ced177a78367560a8b2edda4; owner() is timelock 0x68863fb8855b04509a835082478d6e3d0be4e61a, with getMinDelay()=259200 seconds. That direct implementation mutability is Possible regardless of DAO governance or absence of present freeze hooks. Parent fxUSD/fxSP exposure remains additional: at the same block fxUSD proxy 0x085780639cc2cacd35e474e71f4d000e2405d8f6 resolves to FxUSDRegeneracy 0xf729422d68c2cf00574fb5712972454cf402a9b1, with no token transfer pause and PoolManager-only mint/burn. Its current PoolManager implementation 0xa70dddb8ddd06b1c26061d998e041748b18ecf85 uses _msgSender() as the from address for every fxUSD burn call, not arbitrary victims; legacy mint/earn pause reverts do not establish transfer pause. Parent token upgradeability also qualifies as Possible. Neither parent status nor unmeasured USDC/strategy exposure can displace fxSAVE's own direct Possible surface.

oracleRisk.summary: fxSAVE is an ERC-4626 vault over the f(x) Stability Pool and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation engine. Its required fxUSD parent carries the separately reviewed WBTC and wstETH oracle and liquidation branches.

branchApplicability.rationale: fxSAVE's ERC-4626 share accounting values the underlying Stability Pool position when users mint or redeem vault shares, making that exchange-rate calculation a price-sensitive top-level authority. fxSAVE creates no borrower debt positions or local collateral-ratio liquidation markets, so no branch rows are required.
